content.short: Texas Blockchain promotes blockchain technology through education, development, and networking for UT Austin students and businesses.
content.description: Texas Blockchain provides a collaborative platform for UT Austin students and local businesses to learn and develop blockchain applications. By offering curated educational resources and a regular program of events and hands-on workshops, it helps participants translate blockchain concepts into real-world solutions. The program highlights use cases such as supply chain management, digital identities, and decentralized finance, while offering guidance, practice, and opportunities to prototype projects that apply distributed ledger technology in practical settings.
